note: Reference screenshots for Ludeck - a game logging / wishlist / tracking / sharing app with a 3D navigable tree home screen. Tolan = 3D world + character + spatial navigation patterns. Hypelist = list building, game metadata, social sharing patterns.

screens.why: Baseline 3D home. Character sits small on a rolling hill, camera pulled back, gradient sky. All chrome pushed to screen edges so the 3D scene owns the middle. Chevron at top center collapses/expands the card stack. THE core layout for the Ludeck tree screen.
Expanded card floating over the 3D scene with paged dot indicators. Direct model for surfacing 'latest saved game' cards above the tree without leaving the world.
Same scene, camera dollied in. Shows the zoom range the navigation gesture should cover - tree overview to single-fruit closeup.
Gradient daily card plus a collectible token badge in the top bar and a count bubble on the chevron. Pattern for 'you have N new games to place on the tree'.
Dark card with a constellation motif - node-and-edge graphic. Useful visual language for branch structure / progression.

KEY. Zoomed all the way out - the world becomes a small planet with orbit rings and a + affordance in orbit. Best reference for a zoom-out overview of the whole Ludeck tree, or for switching between multiple trees/branches.
Streak pill ('2 days of friendship') with a flame token, tilted card, live audio waveform along the bottom edge. Streak/consistency framing for a backlog habit.

KEY. Tapping + expands a small stack of pill buttons (Take a photo / Send a photo / Paste a link) anchored bottom-left, + morphs to x. Exactly the add-a-game entry point pattern: paste a store link, scan a box, search.
KEY. Chat bubbles layered directly on the live 3D scene, character stays visible on the left, no modal. Shows how to keep the tree present while a detail/conversation flow runs on top.
Completion moment - green check stamp plus confetti bursting over the card, scene dimmed and blurred behind. The celebration beat for finishing a game / harvesting a fruit.
Card with a photographic thumbnail and a named CTA ('Chat with Sam'). Shows social prompts entering the world layer.

MOST IMPORTANT REFERENCE. World-edit mode: a white placement ring projected onto the terrain, a rotate handle on the ring edge, Done button top-right, and a horizontal inventory tray of owned objects along the bottom with owned-count badges. This is the mechanic for placing a saved game as a fruit on a chosen branch.

KEY. Same mode with a placed object selected: green confirm, red delete, rotate, and a 4-way move puck arranged around the object in world space. The full manipulation gesture kit for arranging fruit.
Character exploring a broader scene with placed props and water ripples. Shows the world reading as inhabited once objects accumulate - the payoff as a tree fills with games.

KEY. Profile as a rendered 3D planet with a serif name, a You/Tolan segmented toggle, an XP bar with a level chip, a next-reward thumbnail, a timed loot crate, and category cards (Wonder / Orbit / Drive) in a bottom rail. Strong model for a Ludeck profile: your tree rendered as the avatar, stats and categories beneath.
Split layout: live 3D preview on a cream field up top, tab strip plus a swatch grid below with the active option ring-selected. Template for tree species / bark / foliage / season customization.
Same layout using grey silhouette thumbnails for shape options, with a reset icon top-right. How to show 3D form choices cheaply - e.g. tree canopy shapes.
Style/Clothes top-level segmented control over scrolling sub-category tabs, with a none/disabled slash option first. Two-level customization IA.
Deeper sub-tab with a dense 3-up grid, preview partially scrolled away. Shows the grid scaling to many cosmetic items.
Onboarding: bold hero 3D character on a saturated backdrop with one caption line and zero other chrome. Sets the 'meet your thing' emotional opener.

KEY. Reveal screen: serif name, trait chips, a descriptive line, a compatibility meter, and a floating 'Meet your Tolan' CTA over a starfield. Template for naming and revealing a freshly planted Ludeck tree.
First-run scene with a low-contrast caption bar and dimmed controls, coaching the user into the world.

KEY. The list card: big editorial cover image, author avatar chip top-left, overflow top-right, item count and title bottom-left, star-save with count bottom-right. The unit of sharing. Ludeck's shared-tree card should borrow this anatomy.

KEY. Search field with an 'Ask AI' pill, trending-query chips with arrow glyphs, then a Trending rail where each card carries a coloured category badge (Games / TV Shows) over key art. Games are first-class here. Note the floating pill tab bar with a black + at center.

KEY. Full-bleed hero carousel ('PC Videogames For You') with author attribution centred beneath and page dots, then category filter pills (For You / TV & Movies / Places), then an 'Up next for you' onboarding nudge. Games-forward home.
Search results scoped by For You / Items / People / Hypelists tabs. Needed for Ludeck: search should resolve to games, people, and trees separately.
Ranked Top 10 rail with oversized numerals behind the artwork, plus personalized rails with bookmark icons on each tile. Good for game charts.
Dark theme rails (Upcoming / Now Playing / Top 10) with bookmark affordance per tile. 'Upcoming' and 'Now Playing' map cleanly to game release tracking.
Social feed entry: user avatar and handle, a compact item card with bookmark, a quoted comment, star rating, then like and reply. How a single save becomes a shareable post.
Dismissible 'People to follow' cards injected mid-feed, with an Invite-your-friends card leading. Growth loop placement.

KEY. Game detail page with Info / Community tabs, a review count badge, sort and filter chips (All Thoughts / Newest / Rating), threaded reactions, an edit-delete popover, and a floating 'Add a thought' FAB. Note the Save pill and star rating pinned in the header over the key art.
KEY. 'Item also added in:' - every other list containing this game, scoped by Everyone / Following / Your Lists. Turns a single game into a discovery hub. Strong differentiator worth copying.

KEY. 'If you like X / You might also like' with real recommendation rows - cover, title, platform-aware one-line description, bookmark to save. Shows how game metadata and platforms are presented compactly.

KEY. Empty list named 'Game Bucket List': gradient cover header with title, a Private lock chip, last-updated date, sort and edit circle buttons, and a hand-drawn arrow pointing at the + in the floating action bar. Best-in-class empty state.

KEY. Same list with one game under a 'Playing' section heading. Row = cover thumb, title, expand chevron, platform line ('Google Stadia - PC'), star rating, overflow. Bottom action bar: Assistant, likes, +, comments, saves.

MOST IMPORTANT LIST REFERENCE. User-defined status sections - Playing / Shelved / Uncategorized - each collapsible. This is exactly Ludeck's tracking model (Wishlist / Playing / Finished / Dropped) and maps 1:1 onto named tree branches.
Multi-select mode: checkbox on each row, sections intact, title now shows the owner ('Alex Game Bucket List') and a Public globe chip. Bulk-move games between branches.
KEY. Completed items get a filled checkbox and strikethrough title while staying in place. The 'finished this game' state without losing history.
Ungrouped view of the same list with black check badges on the right. Shows the sectioned-vs-flat toggle paying off.
KEY. 'NEW' corner ribbons on freshly added rows, developer/studio as the subtitle, and a collapsed sticky header. The 'just saved, not yet placed on the tree' state.

KEY. Edit mode: Change cover in the header, a chip row (Add description / Add images / Add Source), per-section rename pencil with reorder arrow and red delete, and a floating Background / Select Items toolbar. Full list-authoring surface.

KEY. A public list with a painterly custom cover, decorated title, owner avatar, and rows that use bookmark-to-save instead of checkboxes - the read-only visitor view of someone else's list. Bottom bar switches to Add-a-comment plus save and like counts.
Toast pill confirming 'Comments turned off' in the header slot, list untouched beneath. Lightweight per-list privacy control.
KEY. Bottom sheet with a Private/Public segmented control and plain-language consequences for each, then 'Save and share'. Consent-before-share done well.

KEY. Invite Collaborator sheet: user search, suggested people with Invite buttons that flip to an 'Invited' outline state, an 'Invite others' fallback, and a footnote that invitees can add or edit. Co-op branches on a shared tree.

KEY. Share sheet built around a swipeable generated story card carrying the list cover, a sample item, and branding, with an Instagram Stories button on the card, then a friend row and a destination row (Copy Link / QR Code / WhatsApp / Messenger / iMessage). Ludeck should render a share card of the tree here.
KEY. Same sheet switched to a branded QR code with a Download button. Good for sharing a tree in person.
'Link copied' toast with the list thumbnail and a thumbs-up, dropping in over the open share sheet. Confirmation without dismissing context.

KEY. Creation flow: 'New Hypelist' with a name field pre-filled 'Game Bucket List', a cover source strip (Color / Camera Roll / Stock Photos), and a Public chip in the nav that opens the same sharing sheet. The create-a-branch flow.
Profile-level share card with avatar and @handle, plus Report and Block in the destination row. Shows the same sheet generalizing across object types.

KEY. Profile: photo-collage banner, polaroid-framed avatar, name with badges, handle, bio, following and follower counts, Edit Profile plus a theme paint button, then a searchable Hypelists shelf with filter chips - and a long-press menu (Edit / Share / Pin to Profile / Folder Options / Delete). Ludeck's profile equivalent, with the tree in place of the polaroid.
